# Prenatal Screening Timeline Table

| **Gestational Age** | 🦠 **Infectious Disease**                                                                   | 🧬 **Genetic Screening**                                                | 🧫 **Anatomic/Fetal Development**                                          | 🧪 **Maternal Conditions / Labs**                                                                      | 🏥 **Other Clinical Interventions**                  |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| **6–10 weeks**      | - HIV, Hep B/C, RPR (syphilis)  <br>- GC/CT (if <25 or high risk)  <br>- UA & urine culture | - Genetic carrier screening  <br>- Counseling on options                | - Dating ultrasound (if uncertain LMP)                                     | - CBC, TSH (if high risk)  <br>- ABO/Rh, antibody screen                                               | - Initial prenatal visit  <br>- Pap (if due)         |
| **10–13 weeks**     | _No new tests unless high risk_                                                             | - **NIPT / cfDNA** (≥10 wks)  <br>- **NT + PAPP-A + β-hCG** (11–13 wks) | - **Nuchal translucency US** (11–13 wks)                                   | - Baseline BP, weight                                                                                  | - CVS (if indicated)                                 |
| **14–18 weeks**     | - Repeat STI if high risk                                                                   | - Quad screen (if first tri screen not done)                            | - Assess for neural tube defects via AFP                                   | - Screen for anemia (if symptoms)                                                                      | - Amniocentesis (if indicated)                       |
| **18–22 weeks**     | _No routine ID tests_                                                                       | - Anatomy scan can show anatomic markers for aneuploidy                 | - **Anatomy ultrasound**  <br>- Evaluate fetal heart, spine, brain, organs | - Fundal height begins (~20 wks)                                                                       | - Evaluate cervical length (TVUS if needed)          |
| **24–28 weeks**     | Repeat RPR<br><br>If high-risk: HIV, RPR, GC/CT                                             | _No new genetic tests unless concern_                                   | - Continue growth tracking                                                 | - **1h GTT** (→ 3h GTT if abnormal)  <br>- **CBC** for anemia  <br>- **Repeat Type & Screen** (if Rh–) | - **Give Rhogam** if Rh–  <br>- **Tdap** (27–36 wks) |
| **32–34 weeks**     | _Only if indicated (repeat STI, UTI)_                                                       | _No routine genetic testing_                                            | - Fetal position, growth via US (if concern)                               | - Evaluate for preeclampsia symptoms                                                                   | - Birth planning discussions begin                   |
| **36 weeks**        | - **GBS culture** (vaginal/rectal swab)                                                     | _Not applicable_                                                        | - Confirm cephalic presentation  <br>- Cervical exam (if indicated)        | - BP, edema, weight                                                                                    | - Review labor signs, hospital plan                  |
| **37–40 weeks**     | - _Repeat ID tests if late/no care or high-risk exposure_                                   | _Not applicable_                                                        | - Fundal height, fetal movement, US if concern                             | - Weekly BP, UA (if HTN concern)                                                                       | - Consider induction ≥39 wks                         |
| **>40 weeks**       | _No routine ID tests_                                                                       | _Not applicable_                                                        | - **BPP/NST** if postdates or high risk                                    | - Monitor for preeclampsia signs                                                                       | - Offer/plan induction by 41 weeks                   |
